summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved lists not persisting  **Investigation done so far (read-only):** I traced the full path — `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` (fetch with `credentials: "include"`) → `watchlistRouter` auth middleware → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `watchlists`/`watchlist_items` schema. Every layer *appears* correctly scoped: no localStorage/anonymous fallback, no hardcoded watchlist ID, auth middleware mounted on all watchlist routes with no bypass, every query filters by `user_id`, `user_id` is stable per account across logins (not regenerated), cookies are `httpOnly`/`
